node.statement: Dependency bridge for units, norms, bijectivity, and fixed amplifications. Require validated nodes 1.3.2, 1.4, and 1.5.1. Node 1.5.1 gives, for the same four fixed level-one maps, h_jk,n gamma_jk,n=mu_jk,n+d_jk,n with ||d_jk,n(X)||<=kappa*e||X|| (and d=0 off (1,1)); node 1.3.2 gives that every mu_jk,n is an isometric amplification of one bijection; node 1.4 gives ||h_jk,n||<=1+C_H*e, ||h_jk,n^{-1}||<=1+C_H*e, and h_jk,n^{-1}=I_n tensor h_jk^{-1}. For diagonal I, subtracting the H-CB unit estimate yields ||h_jj,n(gamma_jj,n(I)-I_n tensor u_j)||<= (C_H+kappa)e; applying the inverse bound and then ||u_j-P_j||<=C_H*e gives ||gamma_jj,n(I)-I_n tensor P_j||<=3(C_H+kappa)e after a universal threshold reduction. Since mu_jk,n is isometric, (1-kappa*e)||X||<=||mu_jk,n(X)+d_jk,n(X)||<= (1+kappa*e)||X||. The upper bound for h gives ||gamma_jk,n(X)||>=(1-kappa*e)/(1+C_H*e)||X|| >=(1-(C_H+kappa)e)||X||, while its inverse bound gives ||gamma_jk,n(X)||<=(1+C_H*e)(1+kappa*e)||X|| <=(1+2(C_H+kappa)e)||X|| after another universal threshold reduction. Finally gamma_11=v is bijective by the root hypothesis, and for (j,k)!=(1,1), gamma_jk=h_jk^{-1} composed with mu_jk is a bijection; the tensor identities above show that every gamma_jk,n is the amplification of that same level-one map.
